about: The answers of one engine of the Camunda 7 REST family to the reads of the screens Pulse's surfaces share, recorded in one run on 2026-11-20 from the conformance world of @miragon/pulse-engine-core/testing seeded by seedC7World into operaton/operaton:2.1.5 at history level full, and the screens every C7 wire of Pulse builds from them at asOf, in the JSON form of @miragon/pulse-screens: the engine screen and the instance screens of DSP-3001, which waits at its call activity for the incident of the instance it called, and of that called instance. Every id the answers name is this engine's, so a further screen built over them reads the same instances and versions; c7-core's board engine recording is a run of its own with ids of its own.
